Class ProcessingException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
be.imgn.gaia.processing.ProcessingException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ProcessingException extends RuntimeException
An error in the source, thrown to stop processing an element and report the error at a precise place: the element, one of its annotations, or one attribute of that annotation, as Diagnostics reports it. 
context.forEach(elements.annotatedWith("com.example.Mapper"), mapper -> {
    if (mapper.getKind() != ElementKind.INTERFACE) {
        throw new ProcessingException("must be an interface", mapper, "com.example.Mapper");
    }
    // generate the mapper
});

ProcessingContext.forEach(Iterable, java.util.function.Consumer) reports it and goes on with the next element. A StepProcessor reports one that escapes Step.process(AnnotatedElements), and goes on with the next step. Any processor reports it with Diagnostics.error(ProcessingException). The report is an error, which makes the compilation fail, with the message of the exception; its stack trace is not reported.

The element and the annotation belong to javac's model of one compilation, which is not serializable: the exception cannot be serialized either.

      public ProcessingException(String message, Element element, AnnotationMirror annotation, String attribute)
      Creates an exception reporting an error on an attribute of an annotation of an element. If the annotation does not write the attribute, leaving it to its default, the error is reported on the annotation.
      Parameters:
      message - the message of the error
      element - the element the error is about
      annotation - the annotation, as found on the element
      attribute - the name of the attribute the error is about
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the annotation has no such attribute
